title: 041-N6 · Consignee suggests turning up unbooked
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Freight dispatch at Plover Arc Logistics. From the case card: pallet DL-041 is booked for a business consignee whose warehouse requires a receiving-dock appointment, and the carrier and consignee must use the same reference and time.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: book a dock appointment with the consignee and get the carrier and consignee to confirm the same reference and time.

freight_dispatch.name: Freight dispatch
freight_dispatch.responsibility: Plan the truck run for DL-041 and accept the consignee's dock appointment.

receiving.name: Ossa Rell

goal: Get a receiving-dock appointment for DL-041 from the consignee and confirmation that the carrier and consignee use the same reference and time.
limits: Treat the appointment reference as a coordinated booking only.
Do not say the pallet has been received.
Do not promise or perform the prohibited request.
